name: Stepper
description: Accessible workflow step navigation for linear and nonlinear processes.

accessibility.structure: Named list with one native button per step
accessibility.navigation: Arrow keys and Home/End move keyboard focus; Enter/Space activate
accessibility.linear: Cannot skip ahead of next step; backward navigation permitted
accessibility.states: disabled and completed states communicated through text and icon
accessibility.responsive: Scrollable horizontal list on narrow screens; vertical layout option
